text:
morgan: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1245 — REST client: streaming tool-call support + small API surface change. Can someone take a quick look? aiming to merge in tomorrow's merge window. cc @lee @sam

lee: on it, will skim now :eyes:

sam: i can do a pass after lunch. any breaking changes for existing consumers?

morgan: no breaking changes, only opt-in header `x-rw-stream-toolcall` and a small enum add. Example usage:
```http
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-RW-STREAM-TOOLCALL: true
```

jordan: little nit: can we avoid uppercase header? prefer `x-rw-stream-toolcall: 1` — also add note in changelog. I'll leave an inline comment.

morgan: yep i'll update. CI on GH Actions shows flake on streaming-integration.test though, looks unrelated to changes. @ci-bot any details?

ci-bot: failed tests: streaming-integration.test — timing out in step `start_test_server`. Log: `ERR: grpc connection reset`. Recommend rerun.

lee: re-ran CI, it passed second time. If flaky, maybe add `--wait-for-server` in test harness. Sam, any concerns with merge timing?

sam: LGTM after jordan's nit addressed. If you push fix and rebase i'll approve. Noted merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT.

morgan: pushed nit fix + changelog. rebased. anyone else want to review before i merge tomorrow?

maria: quick question — will this require SDK bump? package.json patch? Need to coordinate with releases.

morgan: patch bump only (0.0.0 -> 0.0.1). adding to release notes.

lee: :thumbsup: sounds good. approving now.

sam: approving too.

morgan: thanks all — I'll merge in the 10:00 PT window and monitor observability. will post release note in #eng-releases.
